page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at a base speed of 2.0 GHz, utilizing a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the server bundles three NVIDIA L40S GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, delivering a total of 144 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not included in this configuration.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier (top 10%) for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance (top 25%) for both cached small block reads and uncached large block read and write operations. The server also achieves top-tier status in LLM inference speeds for prompt processing and text generation using small (135M) and medium (7B) models, though benchmark data is unavailable for large (70B) models.

A primary hardware tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation and the complete absence of local storage, which requires external storage solutions. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of GPU resources and system memory relative to the 32 vCPUs offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the overhead of dedicated physical CPU cores.

This configuration is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads such as medium-scale LLM inference, ray tracing, image processing, and complex database operations. It is also suitable for memory-intensive tasks and software compilation.
